# keep·awake

> A free, open-source, single-page web tool that keeps your computer awake and prevents screen sleep or lock. No ads, no accounts, no cookies, no tracking. One open browser tab is all it takes.

The page requests a Screen Wake Lock from the browser and, as a fallback, plays a silent audio loop generated in memory, which keeps the OS from sleeping even when the tab is in the background. It cannot move your mouse cursor: no website can.

- URL: https://keepawake.dev/
- Source: https://github.com/danifernandezs/keep-awake
- License: CC BY-SA 4.0
- Cost: free
- Tech: one static HTML file, zero dependencies, zero external requests
- Languages: English
